description: Use when comparing activity across venues. Each venue with complete figures has 24-hour volume, its portion on events still open, active event and market counts, counts with volume, category volumes, row census coverage, and dated excluded volume when measured. `source_sync` gives the last completed listing cycle and typical period for public venues with known clocks, including venues without summary figures. The response includes the news badge count when available. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana. Cross-venue totals cover Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, Predict, Opinion, Limitless, Myriad and Gemini. Hyperliquid, Seer, MNX and XO Market are excluded by design. `grand_total_volume_24hr` sums measured totals from eligible venues other than Manifold and leaves out the dated excluded figures. `missing_volume_sources` names eligible real-money venues without a measured total. `unavailable_sources` names public venues without complete summary figures.
name: get_summary
title: Per-platform summary
